My plot here is small, just a bit over a quarter of my land, and I am growing something other than the main cereals — maybe some root crop or vegetables for the household. Fertilizer from the cooperative is expensive and often comes late, so for this small plot I will rely on manure from our animals which I have been saving. I will use our own saved seed since improved seed for these minor crops is hard to find anyway. My wife and I will do most of the work ourselves, and I may call on a neighbor for a day or two during planting through our traditional labor sharing.
